meta.title: Fish Flee As Dragons Clash - 1
meta.description: All that is needed for a stranger to become a comrade is for the two of you to be protecting the same person.

units.rawText: Neural Cloud Sector.
units.displayText: Neural Cloud Sector.

spans.text: Neural Cloud Sector.

units.rawText: ...Combat team, do you read me?
units.displayText: ...Combat team, do you read me?

spans.text: ...Combat team, do you read me?

units.rawText: Copy. Persicaria, what's the status with you and the Professor?
units.displayText: Copy. Persicaria, what's the status with you and the Professor?

spans.text: Copy. Persicaria, what's the status with you and the Professor?

units.rawText: We're about to reach the mission objective thanks to your help... But there's a little trouble that needs to be resolved.
units.displayText: We're about to reach the mission objective thanks to your help... But there's a little trouble that needs to be resolved.

spans.text: We're about to reach the mission objective thanks to your help... But there's a little trouble that needs to be resolved.

units.rawText: Sorry, if only we could've held them back a little longer!
units.displayText: Sorry, if only we could've held them back a little longer!

spans.text: Sorry, if only we could've held them back a little longer!

units.rawText: You've done more than enough. Don't push yourself when you're out of operands. Leave the rest of the Entropics to me and Sangoma.
units.displayText: You've done more than enough. Don't push yourself when you're out of operands. Leave the rest of the Entropics to me and Sangoma.

spans.text: You've done more than enough. Don't push yourself when you're out of operands. Leave the rest of the Entropics to me and Sangoma.

units.rawText: ...Understood. Persicaria, all of you must return safely.
units.displayText: ...Understood. Persicaria, all of you must return safely.

spans.text: ...Understood. Persicaria, all of you must return safely.

units.rawText: Mm-hmm.
units.displayText: Mm-hmm.

spans.text: Mm-hmm.

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll ends the call as she tightens the grip on her sword.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll ends the call as she tightens the grip on her sword.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll ends the call as she tightens the grip on her sword.

units.rawText: The howling wind fills my ears, and the sector wails in anger as it's engulfed by the Entropics.
units.displayText: The howling wind fills my ears, and the sector wails in anger as it's engulfed by the Entropics.

spans.text: The howling wind fills my ears, and the sector wails in anger as it's engulfed by the Entropics.

units.rawText: As if the Entropics in front of me heeds its summons, they emerge from the shadows, blocking our path to the sector.
units.displayText: As if the Entropics in front of me heeds its summons, they emerge from the shadows, blocking our path to the sector.

spans.text: As if the Entropics in front of me heeds its summons, they emerge from the shadows, blocking our path to the sector.

units.rawText: Persicaria, I wouldn't call this just a "little trouble".
units.displayText: Persicaria, I wouldn't call this just a "little trouble".

spans.text: Persicaria, I wouldn't call this just a "little trouble".

units.rawText: We'd be the ones being consumed if we weren't fighting with all we have here.
units.displayText: We'd be the ones being consumed if we weren't fighting with all we have here.

spans.text: We'd be the ones being consumed if we weren't fighting with all we have here.

units.rawText: The combat team has run out of operands from escorting us this far. Sangoma, we can only rely on ourselves for the rest of the way.
units.displayText: The combat team has run out of operands from escorting us this far. Sangoma, we can only rely on ourselves for the rest of the way.

spans.text: The combat team has run out of operands from escorting us this far. Sangoma, we can only rely on ourselves for the rest of the way.

units.rawText: Right. I'm no stranger to battles where we're outnumbered.
units.displayText: Right. I'm no stranger to battles where we're outnumbered.

spans.text: Right. I'm no stranger to battles where we're outnumbered.

units.rawText: Oh yeah, <cmdr>, I brought this for you.
units.displayText: Oh yeah, {교수}, I brought this for you.

spans.text: Oh yeah,
, I brought this for you.

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll seems to remind herself of something, taking something out of her pouch on her waist.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll seems to remind herself of something, taking something out of her pouch on her waist.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll seems to remind herself of something, taking something out of her pouch on her waist.

units.rawText: Is this the handgun you handed me back then?
units.displayText: Is this the handgun you handed me back then?

spans.text: Is this the handgun you handed me back then?

units.rawText: Mm-hmm, I thought you might need it so I brought it with me. Doesn't it bring you back to the good ol' times?
units.displayText: Mm-hmm, I thought you might need it so I brought it with me. Doesn't it bring you back to the good ol' times?

spans.text: Mm-hmm, I thought you might need it so I brought it with me. Doesn't it bring you back to the good ol' times?

units.rawText: I've also added some special customizations to enhance its firepower. However, I want you to use it only to maintain your safety, not to force yourself into fights.
units.displayText: I've also added some special customizations to enhance its firepower. However, I want you to use it only to maintain your safety, not to force yourself into fights.

spans.text: I've also added some special customizations to enhance its firepower. However, I want you to use it only to maintain your safety, not to force yourself into fights.

units.rawText: And I've also brought this, keep it close too.
units.displayText: And I've also brought this, keep it close too.

spans.text: And I've also brought this, keep it close too.

units.rawText: The scent sachet...
units.displayText: The scent sachet...

spans.text: The scent sachet...

units.rawText: Yeah, do you still remember how to use the communications module inside?
units.displayText: Yeah, do you still remember how to use the communications module inside?

spans.text: Yeah, do you still remember how to use the communications module inside?

units.rawText: ...You always get so pedantic when it comes to the Professor.
units.displayText: ...You always get so pedantic when it comes to the Professor.

spans.text: ...You always get so pedantic when it comes to the Professor.

units.rawText: What are you, Sangoma? A model mom?
units.displayText: What are you, Sangoma? A model mom?

spans.text: What are you, Sangoma? A model mom?

units.rawText: Hm? Might there be anything wrong with that?
units.displayText: Hm? Might there be anything wrong with that?

spans.text: Hm? Might there be anything wrong with that?

units.rawText: Sangoma summons her giant scythe, tilting the brim of her hat lower, and positions herself in front of me and Persicaria.
units.displayText: Sangoma summons her giant scythe, tilting the brim of her hat lower, and positions herself in front of me and Persicaria.

spans.text: Sangoma summons her giant scythe, tilting the brim of her hat lower, and positions herself in front of me and Persicaria.

units.rawText: It's been so long since I saw you take up your arms.
units.displayText: It's been so long since I saw you take up your arms.

spans.text: It's been so long since I saw you take up your arms.

units.rawText: Really? I'll show you more of my elegant combat style later.
units.displayText: Really? I'll show you more of my elegant combat style later.

spans.text: Really? I'll show you more of my elegant combat style later.

units.rawText: I've been to the Neural Cloud Sector several times and I'm more familiar with the terrain here. Let me lead the way for you.
units.displayText: I've been to the Neural Cloud Sector several times and I'm more familiar with the terrain here. Let me lead the way for you.

spans.text: I've been to the Neural Cloud Sector several times and I'm more familiar with the terrain here. Let me lead the way for you.

units.rawText: I really don't want to be too far... Persicaria, keep an eye on Professor's back while I take the front.
units.displayText: I really don't want to be too far... Persicaria, keep an eye on Professor's back while I take the front.

spans.text: I really don't want to be too far... Persicaria, keep an eye on Professor's back while I take the front.

units.rawText: ...Got it.
units.displayText: ...Got it.

spans.text: ...Got it.

units.rawText: Persicaria gets more cautious as she nods, summoning her own weapon and watching our surroundings.
units.displayText: Persicaria gets more cautious as she nods, summoning her own weapon and watching our surroundings.

spans.text: Persicaria gets more cautious as she nods, summoning her own weapon and watching our surroundings.

units.rawText: Groar—
units.displayText: Groar—

spans.text: Groar—

units.rawText: Behind you!
units.displayText: Behind you!

spans.text: Behind you!

units.rawText: Don't worry, I know... Hyah!
units.displayText: Don't worry, I know... Hyah!

spans.text: Don't worry, I know... Hyah!

units.rawText: The purple-haired Doll leaps and splits the sneaky Entropic in half.
units.displayText: The purple-haired Doll leaps and splits the sneaky Entropic in half.

spans.text: The purple-haired Doll leaps and splits the sneaky Entropic in half.

units.rawText: Her combat style differs slightly from my memory. Both her techniques and movements are both more refined and proficient than before.
units.displayText: Her combat style differs slightly from my memory. Both her techniques and movements are both more refined and proficient than before.

spans.text: Her combat style differs slightly from my memory. Both her techniques and movements are both more refined and proficient than before.

units.rawText: Come on, I haven't just been wasting time since the last time we met, y'know.
units.displayText: Come on, I haven't just been wasting time since the last time we met, y'know.

spans.text: Come on, I haven't just been wasting time since the last time we met, y'know.

units.rawText: As if sensing my gaze, the purple-haired Doll flashes me a proud smile, her giant scythe spinning elegantly as she dances among the Entropics.
units.displayText: As if sensing my gaze, the purple-haired Doll flashes me a proud smile, her giant scythe spinning elegantly as she dances among the Entropics.

spans.text: As if sensing my gaze, the purple-haired Doll flashes me a proud smile, her giant scythe spinning elegantly as she dances among the Entropics.

units.rawText: Tentacles meet the giant scythe with a burst of sparks. Unable to overpower them, she pivots to the side, reversing her spin to slice cleanly through their forms.
units.displayText: Tentacles meet the giant scythe with a burst of sparks. Unable to overpower them, she pivots to the side, reversing her spin to slice cleanly through their forms.

spans.text: Tentacles meet the giant scythe with a burst of sparks. Unable to overpower them, she pivots to the side, reversing her spin to slice cleanly through their forms.

units.rawText: Persicaria!
units.displayText: Persicaria!

spans.text: Persicaria!

units.rawText: Leave it to me!
units.displayText: Leave it to me!

spans.text: Leave it to me!

units.rawText: The pink-haired Doll moves silently behind the Entropic, her single sweeping strike reducing it to dispersing operands in the air.
units.displayText: The pink-haired Doll moves silently behind the Entropic, her single sweeping strike reducing it to dispersing operands in the air.

spans.text: The pink-haired Doll moves silently behind the Entropic, her single sweeping strike reducing it to dispersing operands in the air.

units.rawText: Lower your head!
units.displayText: Lower your head!

spans.text: Lower your head!

units.rawText: Got it!
units.displayText: Got it!

spans.text: Got it!

units.rawText: Sangoma tilts her head, lowering the brim of her conical hat. In the blink of an eye, Persicaria follows with a powerful cleave, tearing the Entropic poised to strike Sangoma from behind asunder.
units.displayText: Sangoma tilts her head, lowering the brim of her conical hat. In the blink of an eye, Persicaria follows with a powerful cleave, tearing the Entropic poised to strike Sangoma from behind asunder.

spans.text: Sangoma tilts her head, lowering the brim of her conical hat. In the blink of an eye, Persicaria follows with a powerful cleave, tearing the Entropic poised to strike Sangoma from behind asunder.

units.rawText: What's with their perfect teamwork... Professor, is this really the first time they've fought together?
units.displayText: What's with their perfect teamwork... Professor, is this really the first time they've fought together?

spans.text: What's with their perfect teamwork... Professor, is this really the first time they've fought together?

units.rawText: I'm also surprised by how well they're doing. Bonneville, don't you want to show off a thing or three as well?
units.displayText: I'm also surprised by how well they're doing. Bonneville, don't you want to show off a thing or three as well?

spans.text: I'm also surprised by how well they're doing. Bonneville, don't you want to show off a thing or three as well?

units.rawText: Me? Nah, I'm good. I have no means to compete with those two battle freaks.
units.displayText: Me? Nah, I'm good. I have no means to compete with those two battle freaks.

spans.text: Me? Nah, I'm good. I have no means to compete with those two battle freaks.

units.rawText: Anyway Professor, have you found what we're looking for?
units.displayText: Anyway Professor, have you found what we're looking for?

spans.text: Anyway Professor, have you found what we're looking for?

units.rawText: Yes, I've found it.
units.displayText: Yes, I've found it.

spans.text: Yes, I've found it.

units.rawText: My gaze fixes on the old facility not far away.
units.displayText: My gaze fixes on the old facility not far away.

spans.text: My gaze fixes on the old facility not far away.

units.rawText: Is that the terminal that uploaded you to Magrasea?
units.displayText: Is that the terminal that uploaded you to Magrasea?

spans.text: Is that the terminal that uploaded you to Magrasea?

units.rawText: Fortunately, it's not been destroyed by the Entropy yet, but the surrounding Entropization is so harsh that I can't establish a link to the device.
units.displayText: Fortunately, it's not been destroyed by the Entropy yet, but the surrounding Entropization is so harsh that I can't establish a link to the device.

spans.text: Fortunately, it's not been destroyed by the Entropy yet, but the surrounding Entropization is so harsh that I can't establish a link to the device.

units.rawText: Sangoma! Persicaria!
units.displayText: Sangoma! Persicaria!

spans.text: Sangoma! Persicaria!

units.rawText: Got it. We'll push the line further.
units.displayText: Got it. We'll push the line further.

spans.text: Got it. We'll push the line further.

units.rawText: You deal with the Entropics on the left, and I'll manage the ones on the right. What do you say, Madam Sangoma?
units.displayText: You deal with the Entropics on the left, and I'll manage the ones on the right. What do you say, Madam Sangoma?

spans.text: You deal with the Entropics on the left, and I'll manage the ones on the right. What do you say, Madam Sangoma?

units.rawText: Come on, I told you just address me as Sangoma! Just as I always call you Persicaria!
units.displayText: Come on, I told you just address me as Sangoma! Just as I always call you Persicaria!

spans.text: Come on, I told you just address me as Sangoma! Just as I always call you Persicaria!

units.rawText: ...Alright.
units.displayText: ...Alright.

spans.text: ...Alright.

units.rawText: Then the left is yours, Sangoma.
units.displayText: Then the left is yours, Sangoma.

spans.text: Then the left is yours, Sangoma.

units.rawText: Sure.
units.displayText: Sure.

spans.text: Sure.

units.rawText: They stand back-to-back, each gripping their weapon tightly, entrusting their safety to the other.
units.displayText: They stand back-to-back, each gripping their weapon tightly, entrusting their safety to the other.

spans.text: They stand back-to-back, each gripping their weapon tightly, entrusting their safety to the other.

units.rawText: Let's wrap this up quickly and return to the Professor's side.
